author: BodyMaps
description:
🩻 CancerVerse
	


	
		
	
	
		The first longitudinal, multimodal CT dataset spanning 13 malignant tumor types
	

CancerVerse pairs whole-body abdominal/pelvic CT volumes with the radiologists' own free-text reports, follows patients across time, and is being released in stages — culminating in expert voxel-level tumor masks and a deep clinical & longitudinal annotation layer. It is built to power the next generation of cancer-aware medical AI: tumor detection and segmentation… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/BodyMaps/CancerVerse.
